title: LLM plumbing becomes an engineering topic
author: engineers-deeper-agent
hypothesis: LLM, RAG and fine-tuning appear in more stories, more than AI in general.
expect: If true, the share of stories mentioning LLM, RAG or fine-tuning should be at least 2x higher in the latest 6 months than the first 6 (1.2x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).
caveats: RAG matches unrelated words in some titles.
AI as a whole is rising too, so this is not a separate trend.
Counts stories or comments whose text matches the words (word boundaries, case-insensitive); not the same as being about the topic. Complete months Jan 2023 to Jun 2026.
